skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have the same denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Rename fractions using a common denominator and subtract them.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: Borrow one whole to subtract in mixed-number problems when the minuend's fractional part is smaller.

skills.name: Whole-number minuend subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract a fraction or mixed number from a whole number by decomposing the whole number.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert nonstandard mixed numbers with improper fractional parts into standard mixed numbers before subtracting.
